name: @talisman-cms/plugin-analytics
description: Cloudflare Web Analytics and optional Commerce reporting for Talisman CMS
author: Jakob Holmelund

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/cloudflare.ts src/commerce.ts src/ask.ts src/routes/analytics-overview.ts src/routes/analytics-commerce.ts src/routes/analytics-ask.ts --format esm --dts --clean --external cloudflare:workers --external astro --external virtual:talisman-cms/config
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!/^pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Publish with pnpm (pnpm release:publish) so workspace: ranges are rewritten and LICENSE.md is packed.'); process.exit(1); }"
